What is Tim Sort? 🤔
Tim Sort is an adaptive, stable, and efficient sorting algorithm designed to perform well on many kinds of real-world data. It combines the strengths of merge sort and insertion sort.

Key Features:
✅ Adaptive: Faster on already sorted or partially sorted data.
✅ Stable: Preserves the relative order of equal elements.
✅ Efficient: Scales well with large datasets.
